# Copper Scroll Column 5 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Date:** 2026-03-17

This log records all lines in Copper Scroll Column 5 (treasure locations 17-20) where the three translators diverged, along with SOPHIA's resolution.

---

## 5:1 — underground passage/tunnel

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the underground passage" — standard rendering |
| LOGOS | "the underground passage" — same |
| PNEUMA | "the tunnel" — simplified |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the underground passage" per EMET/LOGOS. "Tunnel" implies a through-passage which may not be accurate.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 5:3-4 — entrance being under / access through

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the entrance being under the western corner" |
| LOGOS | "access is through the western corner" |
| PNEUMA | "enter from the western corner" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's phrasing preserving "entrance" (petach) and the preposition "under."

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 5:8 — all of it is offering / the whole being / all dedicated

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "all of it is offering" — literal kulo qorban |
| LOGOS | "the whole being an offering" — formal |
| PNEUMA | "all of which are dedicated as offerings" — expanded |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's "all of it is offering" as the most direct rendering of kulo qorban.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

## 5:9 — dovecote/pigeon tower

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "the dovecote" — standard for shovakh |
| LOGOS | "the dovecote" — same |
| PNEUMA | "the pigeon tower" — descriptive |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted "the dovecote" per EMET/LOGOS. This is the standard English term for shovakh.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET/LOGOS.

---

## 5:11-12 — seventh treasure phrasing

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "offerings of the seventh treasure" |
| LOGOS | "offerings from the seventh treasure" |
| PNEUMA | "offerings belonging to the seventh cache of treasure" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted LOGOS's "offerings from the seventh treasure" — "from" better indicates the source relationship.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of LOGOS.

---

## 5:13 — mouth/opening + well of water/water well

| Translator | Rendering | Rationale |
|---|---|---|
| EMET | "At the mouth of the well of water" — literal pi be'er ha-mayim |
| LOGOS | "At the opening of the water well" — reordered |
| PNEUMA | "At the mouth of the water well" — hybrid |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** Adopted EMET's word order "the well of water" preserving Hebrew construct chain. "Mouth" for pi is standard.

**Status:** Resolved in favor of EMET.

---

*Total disagreements in Column 5: 6*
